name: resource-explorer-2
description: Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer is a resource search and discovery service.

subcommands.name: associate-default-view
subcommands.description: Sets the specified view as the default for the Amazon Web Services Region in which you call this operation.

subcommands.name: batch-get-view
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a list of views.

subcommands.name: create-index
subcommands.description: Turns on Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer in the Amazon Web Services Region in which you called this operation by creating an index.

subcommands.name: create-resource-explorer-setup
subcommands.description: Creates a Resource Explorer setup configuration across multiple Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: create-view
subcommands.description: Creates a view that users can query by using the Search operation.

subcommands.name: delete-index
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified index and turns off Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer in the specified Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-explorer-setup
subcommands.description: Deletes a Resource Explorer setup configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-view
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified view.

subcommands.name: disassociate-default-view
subcommands.description: After you call this operation, the affected Amazon Web Services Region no longer has a default view.

subcommands.name: get-account-level-service-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of your account's Amazon Web Services service access, and validates the service linked role required to access the multi-account search feature.

subcommands.name: get-default-view
subcommands.description: Retrieves the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the view that is the default for the Amazon Web Services Region in which you call this operation.

subcommands.name: get-index
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about the Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer index in the Amazon Web Services Region in which you invoked the operation.

subcommands.name: get-managed-view
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of the specified Amazon Web Services-managed view.

subcommands.name: get-resource-explorer-setup
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status and details of a Resource Explorer setup operation.

subcommands.name: get-service-index
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the Resource Explorer index in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: get-service-view
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific Resource Explorer service view.

subcommands.name: get-view
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of the specified view.

subcommands.name: list-indexes
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all of the indexes in Amazon Web Services Regions that are currently collecting resource information for Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer.

subcommands.name: list-indexes-for-members
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of a member's indexes in all Amazon Web Services Regions that are currently collecting resource information for Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer.

subcommands.name: list-managed-views
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon resource names (ARNs) of the Amazon Web Services-managed views available in the Amazon Web Services Region in which you call this operation.

subcommands.name: list-resources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of resources and their details that match the specified criteria.

subcommands.name: list-service-indexes
subcommands.description: Lists all Resource Explorer indexes across the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: list-service-views
subcommands.description: Lists all Resource Explorer service views available in the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-streaming-access-for-services
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon Web Services services that have been granted streaming access to your Resource Explorer data.

subcommands.name: list-supported-resource-types
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all resource types currently supported by Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-views
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon resource names (ARNs) of the views available in the Amazon Web Services Region in which you call this operation.

subcommands.name: search
subcommands.description: Searches for resources and displays details about all resources that match the specified criteria.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tag key and value pairs to an Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer view or index.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tag key and value pairs from an Amazon Web Services Resource Explorer view or index.

subcommands.name: update-index-type
subcommands.description: Changes the type of the index from one of the following types to the other.

subcommands.name: update-view
subcommands.description: Modifies some of the details of a view.
